note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry in our own words, with sources cited beside each trophy. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned; there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours to the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, and finish with the 100% checklist. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with A Long Road the longest grind.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of Chapter 1 and unlocks automatically as the story starts — you cannot miss it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the opening chapter; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Automatic and unmissable, like all 12 story trophies.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The chapter trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. This is also when both protagonists become playable, opening most of the free-roam list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play through the chapter; the trophy unlocks automatically at its end. Robbery trophies start opening up around Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The chapter trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission — this is the gold story trophy, and finishing the story unlocks the 100% Completion checklist under Progress, then Stats. Automatic once the finale is done; free roam continues after the credits.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done — all story-mission trophies are unmissable, so just play the mission when it appears.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A named story mission — the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A named story mission — the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A named story mission — the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A named story mission at the airport — the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission — the trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. After the finale, the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — everything you did during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient (PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion): story, 100 optional tasks, robberies, fencing totals, collectibles, activities and scanning. Nothing on it is missable — it can all be finished in free roam. Save this for last; most of it falls out of the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — the game counts 397 stunt spots in total, so you need a little over half. Chain them during free roam and while travelling between missions; the Progress menu tracks your count. Stunts also feed the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of every activity in Leonida — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest. The Progress menu shows which types you have tried; a natural early trophy if you try everything as you explore.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold every challenge at the ranges — gold needs speed and accuracy, not just completion. Learn each range's targets first, then work through them one by one with the weapon you handle best.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line with a practice run first, then race for the win. Drone races unlock as you discover their locations across Leonida.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win 20 distinct race events across Leonida — different races, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types as you travel; the Progress menu tracks which you have won.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge — out-fish him to take the trophy. Fishing challenges appear as you explore Leonida's waters; bring your best rod and bait.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end — pick the shortest one you like and finish a full game. Arcades are scattered around Leonida's towns.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.caution: Start this strand as soon as it unlocks — one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play through Andy's stranger strand to its last mission. Start stranger strands as soon as they unlock — one guide warns their windows are tied to story progress, so do not leave them all until after the finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.caution: Start this strand as soon as it unlocks — one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play through Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission. Start stranger strands as soon as they unlock — one guide warns their windows are tied to story progress.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.caution: Start this strand as soon as it unlocks — one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play through Billy's stranger strand to its last mission. Start stranger strands as soon as they unlock — one guide warns their windows are tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Finish 8 full stranger strands — the five named characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more. Start strands when they appear; they are the long tail of the side content and they feed the Strangers & Freaks count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.caution: Start this strand as soon as it unlocks — one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play through Randy's stranger strand to its last mission. Start stranger strands as soon as they unlock — one guide warns their windows are tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.caution: Start this strand as soon as it unlocks — one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play through Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission. Start stranger strands as soon as they unlock — one guide warns their windows are tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY (PowerPyx). The first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is not confirmed whether that session counts toward the trophy — doing it is the safe choice, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia first (see the missable warning above), then work through the other 17 spots as you explore — the Progress menu tracks your count.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it. Study animals through the binoculars first — studying 100 of the 255 animals also feeds the 100% checklist, so the hunt and the checklist overlap.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets hidden across Leonida; finish any 3 full sets. Cards are the classic collectible hunt — sweep each area as you explore, and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 sets, so you have slack.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find 100 WAiNK spots and use the WAiNK feature at each. This is a long grind — fold it into your exploration of all 52 areas so you are not backtracking across the map for it alone.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game tracks dozens of challenges — stunts, combat, driving and more — and you need any 50 of them. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; check the Progress menu to see which are close, then mop up the easy ones.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Do it in open country with a fast car and a plan to disappear — alleys and tunnels help.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner riding along — and keep your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route with three close shops and a getaway car waiting.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Spot 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Surveying vehicles counts toward discovery — the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy and the checklist overlap; scan as you travel.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight and line the shots up first — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout works.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without following the script. Any aircraft at VCIA will do; get airborne and away.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get up close with Rhino tanks and survive the encounter — the trophy is about tangling with the military hardware and coming out the other side. Bring heavy weapons, use cover, and do not stand in the open.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, slip in unseen and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm. Go quiet: no shooting, no smashing until you are clear — detection fails the attempt.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vault jobs unlock as you progress — plan each one, bring your partner if the job calls for it, and escape before the response arrives.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and escape the response. Trucks run set routes — pick a quiet stretch of road, block it, and be gone before backup arrives.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the map. The WAiNK hunt and vehicle scanning both push you into every corner, so this lands naturally if you explore thoroughly — check the map for areas you have not set foot in.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs running illegal operations — rob one operation per gang. Each gang's turf shows as you explore; work through all nine, one operation each.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact spot was not confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this among the trophies whose unlock was not yet known when its guide was written, so check the cited guide for the latest community findings.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive out of a vehicle showroom through the glass, in classic GTA style. The exact showroom was not confirmed at launch — see PowerPyx for the latest findings from the community.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through on your throw. A short activity trophy — do it when you pass the alley.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A moment with your partner that the public notices. The exact trigger was not confirmed at launch — keep playing partner activities and watch for it, and check the cited guides for community updates.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make story and side choices — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500. Choices accumulate across the whole game, so play naturally and make the calls when they come; the count ticks up as you go. Keep a manual save before big story choices as cheap insurance.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second attempt at something that beat you the first time. The exact trigger was not confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists it among the unconfirmed ones; check the cited guide for what the community has found.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida. A rare odd event — keep your eyes open while exploring, especially off the beaten track. The exact event was not confirmed at launch per PowerPyx, so check the cited guide for the latest community findings.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact setup was not confirmed at launch — see PowerPyx for the latest community method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Fence $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — launder them steadily through your contacts and the total adds up over the game.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles, weapons and gear all add up over a full playthrough, so this lands naturally if you shop as you go.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save up during the story and buy them as you find them — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for the Scooter Bros app.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles you own through the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles will do — register the ones you actually drive, and use your garages to store them.
